# Lending

## Requirements

- ITEM-0001 Loans
  - REQ-0001 A member borrows at most ten books at once.
  - REQ-0002 A loan lasts three weeks.
  - ITEM-0002 Renewals
    - REQ-0003 A loan is renewed twice at most.
- ITEM-0004 Reservations
  - REQ-0005 A reserved book is kept for a week.
